For licensed therapists trained in EMDR, online

EMDR consultation

Reem Glasco is an EMDRIA Approved Consultant, certified in EMDR and trained in the ASSYST-I, PRECI and IGTP-OTS protocols. Individual consultation is online and starts with a free consult to check fit. The emphasis is IFS-informed EMDR for phases one and two, with Somatic Experiencing, Brainspotting and NARM interweaves where they help.

Request a consult What EMDRIA requires

What we work on

  • Preparation and stabilization that actually holds, so phase four does not collapse back into overwhelm.
  • IFS-informed EMDR for phases one and two, particularly with clients who have parts that object to the work.
  • Titration and pacing for clients with developmental trauma, where standard protocol timing is too fast.
  • Interweaves drawn from Somatic Experiencing, NARM and Brainspotting, and knowing when not to reach for one.
  • Acute and ongoing stress protocols, including ASSYST and group protocols.
  • Transference and countertransference as clinical information, with your own nervous system treated as part of the data.

What EMDRIA asks for, and where these hours fit

Certification is not a course you finish. It is a set of conditions EMDRIA checks when you apply, and consultation is the one that takes longest to accumulate. Here is the shape of it, so you can see what you already have.

EMDRIA Certified Therapist requirements
What EMDRIA requiresThe detail
Full licensureLicensed for independent practice in your state
Basic trainingAn EMDRIA-approved EMDR Basic Training, completed in full
Two yearsIn your licensed field
50 sessions, 25 clientsEMDR sessions conducted after Basic Training
20 consultation hoursAt least 10 individual, with at least 5 from a full Approved Consultant rather than a Consultant in Training. Within the five years before you apply.
12 EMDRIA CreditsContinuing education earned after Basic Training
LettersOne from an Approved Consultant, plus two from peers

Reem is a full EMDRIA Approved Consultant, so hours with her count toward the whole twenty and toward the five that a Consultant in Training cannot supply. Certification is granted for two years and renewed. These are EMDRIA's criteria rather than this practice's, and they change, so check the current list with EMDRIA (opens in a new tab) before you plan around them.

If you are going further

Consultant in Training is the next step after certification, and it also needs 20 hours, at least 10 individual, of consultation on your own consulting. Reem takes consultants in training as well as therapists working toward certification.

Who tends to book this

The therapist accumulating hours

You are working toward certification and need individual hours from a full Approved Consultant. Bring live cases; the hours and the help are the same hours.

The one whose processing keeps collapsing

Preparation looks adequate, then phase four floods or flatlines. Usually a protective part was never consulted, and the fix is upstream of where it went wrong.

The one trained years ago

You did Basic Training, used it for a while, and drifted. Common, and a fine place to start. We rebuild from the preparation phases rather than from the manual.

The consultant in training

You are certified and building toward Approved Consultant. What you need is consultation on your consulting, which is a different conversation from case work.

What an hour looks like

Bring a case, ideally one that is not going well. Recordings are welcome and not required. Most of the hour is spent on the part of the work before reprocessing, because that is where most of the trouble starts.

Your own responses in the room are treated as clinical information rather than as something to manage privately. If a client's material is doing something to your nervous system, that is data about the case as well as about you.

Individual hours are scheduled as you need them rather than on a fixed rota, which suits accumulating twenty of them around a full caseload.

The first conversation is free and exists to check fit. If what you need is closer to supervision, training or a different consultant, that is a useful thing to find out in thirty minutes.

Consultation questions

Do these hours count toward EMDR certification?

Yes. EMDRIA requires 20 consultation hours, at least 10 of them individual, and at least 5 from a full Approved Consultant rather than a Consultant in Training. Reem is a full Approved Consultant, so her hours count toward all of it. The table above has the rest of the requirements, and EMDRIA sets them, so confirm the current list with them.

How much does EMDR consultation cost?

$185 for an individual online hour. LPC Associates under Reem's supervision receive individual EMDR consults at no additional cost.

I am not in Texas. Can we still work together?

Consultation is a peer professional relationship rather than clinical care, so it is not limited to Texas in the way therapy and LPC supervision are. Check what your own licensing board expects of your consultation arrangements.

What if my EMDR training was years ago?

That is common and it is a fine place to start. Bring a case you feel stuck on and we will rebuild confidence from the preparation phases forward rather than starting from the manual.

How can I learn more?

The frequently asked questions page collects everything that is not specific to one service: fees and insurance, how the methods differ, complex PTSD, what Texas requires of a counselor, and how to start. If the answer is not there either, a free consult is the quickest way to get one.
